checklist.json CHK-003 context: "(F-023 path)" is a code-level finding label that is not expanded inline; the surrounding phrase "error-surfaced-as-warning behavior" provides enough inferrable context for an implementer, but the label itself is opaque to a first-time reader. Recommend adding a one-clause expansion such as "(F-023: errors surfaced as warnings, not swallowed)".
